rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The magicians' apparent victory was only a ruse; divine power overturned it, defeated their schemes, and frustrated their hope.
rows.anchor: فبيناهم في توهم أن الغلبة لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God disclosed inward love beneath outward enmity and can reverse who appears friend or foe, while bringing the decreed outcome to pass.
rows.anchor: على الوهلة فأصبحوا في صدر العداوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers' inward secrets had left the prison of forms, their hearts were cleansed of imagined separation, and gnosis had dawned within them.
rows.anchor: وأن قلوبهم طهرت عن توهم التفرقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They witnessed God with sound insight, so the self's threats no longer ruled them and no pretext remained between them and God.
rows.anchor: ولم يبق لتخويفات النفس فيهم سلطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because their destination was God, the hardships they met on the way to Him became easy to bear.
rows.anchor: لما كان مصيرهم إلى الله سهل عليهم ما لقوا في مسيرهم إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who act and suffer for God seek His aid sincerely; the way of one devoted wholly to God is to rely wholly on Him.
rows.anchor: كذا سنة من كان الله أن يكون كله على الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh refused to admit his inability to subdue Moses and his people, threatened them, and found his plan reversed by God's decree.
rows.anchor: فتوعد موسى وقومه بما عكس الله عليه تدبيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses directs the people to God because he himself returns to God when perplexed; they should likewise turn to and rely upon Him.
rows.anchor: رجوعي - عند تحيري في أموري - إلى ربي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses urges them to trust God and expose themselves to His gentle openings, since He has promised patient people a beautiful final outcome.
rows.anchor: فإنه حكم لأهل الصبر بجميل العقبى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their obscured vision of reality made them complain that afflictions kept arriving and hardship had preceded Moses' coming.
rows.anchor: خفي عليهم شهود الحقيقة ، وغشي على أبصارهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses answers their despair by holding out hope that God will destroy their enemy, placing them in expectation of relief.
rows.anchor: بما علق رجاءهم بكشف البلاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who sees with the eye of inner insight can witness the changing courses of divine decree.
rows.anchor: ومن شهد ببصر الأسراء شهد تصاريف الأقدار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God intensified the pressure of His power after multiplying blessings, yet neither severity nor abundance awakened the people.
rows.anchor: شدد عليهم وطأة القدرة بعدما ضاعف لديهم أسباب النعمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They treated ease as something owed to them and blamed Moses superstitiously when hardship came.
rows.anchor: إن مسهم يسر لاحظوه بعين الاستحقاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once the people recognized the ugliness of their deed, they drank the cup of regret and feared loss unless God's gentle favor rescued them.
rows.anchor: حين تحققوا بقبح صنيعهم تجرعوا كاسات الأسف ندما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even a harmonious reunion with his people would have been troubled for Moses by losing intimate speech with God and returning to witness created beings.
rows.anchor: لكان متنغص العيش لما مني به من حرمان سماع الخطاب والرد إلى شهود الأغيار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses faced several possible ordeals: loss of divine speech, being kept from asking to see God, and witnessing Israel's temptation and desire for the calf.
rows.anchor: ولا يدرى أي المحن كانت أشد على موسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing that his people were tested affected Moses less than seeing their condition with his own eyes.
rows.anchor: لما شاهدهم أثرت فيه المشاهدة بما لم يؤثر فيه السماع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Harun says “son of my mother” to soften Moses and appeal for mercy.
rows.anchor: فذكر الأم هنا للاسترفاق والاسترحام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Harun's plea about his beard and head says he has endured repeated ordeals and asks Moses not to add to his suffering but to console him.
rows.anchor: قد توالت المحن علي فذرني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Harun's appeal softened Moses, who returned to God in supplication and confessed his need for forgiveness and mercy.
rows.anchor: وعند ذلك رق له موسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant should seek forgiveness in every circumstance and recognize that God may punish even an innocent person, since all creation belongs to Him.
rows.anchor: وجوب الاستغفار على العبد في عموم الأحوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The owner's disposal of what belongs to Him is effective; this grounds the claim that God may punish even the blameless.
rows.anchor: تصرف المالك في ملكه نافذ

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: An unnamed interpretation assigns the sin to the Israelites and the apologetic to Moses and Harun, as an expression of pure servitude.
rows.anchor: ارتكاب الذنب كان من بني إسرائيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The threatened recompense is future; God's delay is respite rather than neglect, so sinners must not mistake the absence of immediate punishment for safety.
rows.anchor: ولا ينبغي لمن يذنب ثم لا يؤاخذ في الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One possible meaning of faith after repentance is believing that God accepts repentance.
rows.anchor: آمنوا بأنه يقبل التوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another possible meaning is believing that human disobedience does not harm God.
rows.anchor: آمنوا بأن الحق سبحانه لم يضره عصيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading is that repentance alone cannot save without God's grace.
rows.anchor: آمنوا بأنهم لا ينجون بتوبتهم من دون فضل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation says they recognized their earlier covenant-breaking as shirk.
rows.anchor: أو آمنوا أي عدوا ما سبق منهم من نقض العهد شركا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase may mean they persisted in faith and met their end as believers.
rows.anchor: ويقال استداموا للإيمان فكان موافاتهم على الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another possibility is that they believed returning to covenant-breaking and neglecting commands would make them fall from God's favor; each escape is not guaranteed.
rows.anchor: ترك العهد وتضييع الأمر سقطوا من عين الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's forbearance is especially visible when a person is overwhelmed by an unseen impulse beyond their power to resist; if prophets can be overtaken, others are even more vulnerable.
rows.anchor: غلب عليه ما لا يطيق رده من بواده الغيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is a contrast between a community selected by its prophet and one selected by God: Moses' chosen group demanded to see God openly and were struck.
rows.anchor: أرنا الله جهرة فأخذتهم الصاعقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those whom God chose are promised radiant faces looking toward their Lord, unlike the group Moses selected.
rows.anchor: وجوه يومئذ ناضرة إلى ربها ناظرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses speaks candidly of the trial as God's, then entrusts its outcome to God's will and follows with a plea for forgiveness and mercy.
rows.anchor: بنعت التحقيق وفارق الحشمة وقال صريحا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses places praise of God as their protector before asking Him to forgive and show mercy.
rows.anchor: أنت ولينا فاغفر لنا وارحمنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks for good in both lives from a posture of need and sincere supplication; “write it for us” means guide us to You.
rows.anchor: نطق بلسان التضرع والابتهال حيث صفى إليه الحاجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' prayer signals the Prophet Muhammad's distinctive realization of disowning personal power and returning wholly to God.
rows.anchor: وفي هذه إشارة إلى تخصيص نبينا - - في التبري من الحول والقوة والرجوع إلى الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet Muhammad expresses complete reliance by asking not to be left to himself even for an instant, asking for care like a child, and admitting he cannot encompass God's praise.
rows.anchor: لا تكلني إلى نفسي طرفة عين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “We have turned to You” means turning toward God's religion and belonging to Him entirely, with no reserve left for oneself.
rows.anchor: ملنا إلى دينك ، وصرنا لك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God says punishment strikes whom He wills, rather than saying that no one escapes it; punishment is conditional on His will.
rows.anchor: عذابي لا أخلي منه أحدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine acts are not caused by people's deeds: the verse says punishment reaches whom God wills, not only sinners.
rows.anchor: عذابي أصيب به العصاة بل قال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because God may choose not to punish anyone, the verse affirms His freedom to forgive whom He wills.
rows.anchor: أصيب به من أشاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Punishment, an attribute of divine action, is tied to will; mercy, an eternal attribute of the divine essence, is not tied to will.
rows.anchor: فلما كان العذاب من صفات الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that mercy encompasses everything gives sinners hope, since they too are included among things.
rows.anchor: لأنهم وإن لم يكونوا من جملة المطيعين والعبادين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's promise to prescribe mercy for believers establishes their reward by His word, though no one has an independent claim against God.
rows.anchor: فيجب الثواب للمؤمنين من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who fear God avoid imagining that they deserve mercy; recognizing that divine judgments are not caused by their deeds, they receive mercy by God's decree.
rows.anchor: يجتنبون أن يروا الرحمة باستحقاقهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Belief in God's signs includes both disclosures grasped through reasoning and subtle inward intimations experienced in varied spiritual states.
rows.anchor: مما يجدونه في أنفسهم من فنون الأحوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's unletteredness shows that his virtues, comprehensive knowledge, and readiness to set out law came from God, not study, effort, or independent reasoning.
rows.anchor: من فضائله وكمال علمه وتهيؤه إلى تفصيل شرعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good is fulfilling God's right; evil is remaining in self-interest, desire, wishful claims, and self-deception, with the Sacred Law distinguishing the two.
rows.anchor: المنكر هو البقاء بوصف الحظوظ وأحكام الهوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What is good is what the Owner of all things permits; what is bad is what accords with prohibition, and the Sacred Law separates them.
rows.anchor: فالحسن من أفعال العباد ما كان بنعت الإذن من مالك الأعيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heaviest burden is anxious self-management; leaving it for the ease of witnessing God's decree removes that burden.
rows.anchor: ولا شيء أثقل من كد التدبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shackles are self-imposed devotional obligations beyond what God required; people relied on their own power, neglected them, and broke their pledges.
rows.anchor: هي ما ابتدعوه من قبل أنفسهم باختيارهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who welcome what decree brings with contentment and see God in events receive blessing and favor.
rows.anchor: وشهد الحق في أجناس الأحداث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse acknowledges the believers' support for the Messenger, while affirming that God's support suffices him and his success does not depend on people.
rows.anchor: ومن كان استقلاله بالحق لم يقف انتعاشه على نصرة الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent the Messenger to all people and commands them to obey him, avoid what he forbids, and follow the unlettered Prophet to attain success in both lives.
rows.anchor: تحذروا من ارتكاب ما يزجركم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's followers are those for whom divine care and prior mercy were decreed, preserving them from distortion and sudden change.
rows.anchor: وصدقت فيهم الولاية فبقوا على الحق من غير تحريف ولا تحويل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their hearts fail to understand the revealed address as its reciters understand it, and they cannot distinguish divine promptings from the self's thoughts and Satan's whispers.
rows.anchor: ليس لهم تمييز بين خواطر الحق وبين هواجس النفس ووساوس الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their eyes do not see the proofs of divine unity and signs of certainty; they look only through heedlessness.
rows.anchor: يبصرون بها شواهد التوحيد وعلامات اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their ears heed only invitations to temptation, and they associate only with those who pursue their desires.
rows.anchor: ولا ينخرطون إلا مع من سلك ركوب الشهوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cattle are not charged with religious duties and so do not oppose commands; people are worse when bound to self and desire yet heed only eating and sex.
rows.anchor: الأنعام قد رفع عنها التكليف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The poem depicts a heedless person who spends day and night in inattention and sleep, living as beasts do.
rows.anchor: نهارك يا مغرور سهو وغفلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God makes Himself known to His friends through His names and attributes, disclosing what is necessary, possible, or impossible of Him to their hearts.
rows.anchor: فتجلى لقلوبهم بما يكاشفهم به من أسمائه وصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reason cannot directly grasp what may properly be ascribed to God, though it can recognize what is necessary, possible, and impossible of Him.
rows.anchor: فإن العقول محجوبة عن الهجوم بذواتها بما يصح إطلاقه في وصفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reason knows the broad categories, while revealed law governs what can be said of God: report what transmission permits and refrain where it is silent.
rows.anchor: وما سكت عنه التوفيق يمنع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ilhad means turning away from the right course, either by adding to the truth or subtracting from it.
rows.anchor: الإلحاد هو الميل عن القصد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anthropomorphists deviate by excess, while those who negate divine attributes deviate by deficiency.
rows.anchor: فأهل التمثيل زادوا فألحدوا ، وأهل التعطيل نقصوا فألحدوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's customary order leaves the world with people who sustain its flourishing and keep the truth manifest.
rows.anchor: ألا يخلي البسيطة من أهل لها هم الغياث وبهم دوام الحق في الظهور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's people summon others to truth, direct them to it, act and rest through it, and stand by it as succor for creation.
rows.anchor: هدايتهم بالحق أنهم يدعون إلى الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These spiritual helpers bring relief: people receive rain in drought and their prayers are answered.
rows.anchor: إذا أجدبوا ، ويجابون إذا دعوا

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: One account of spiritual delusion is imagining oneself close to God when one's share in destiny is actually separation.
rows.anchor: أن يلقى في أوهامهم أنهم من أهل الوصلة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another account is gaining a good reputation among people while concealing evil from God.
rows.anchor: انتشار الصيت بالخير في الخلق

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another account is that every increase in companionship is accompanied by a decrease in spiritual rank.
rows.anchor: ويقال الاستدراج ألا يزداد في المستقبل صحبة إلا ازداد في الاستحقاق نقصان رتبة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another account is falling from an imagined pure state into reprehensible action; a truly sincere state would protect conduct.
rows.anchor: ويقال الاستدراج الرجوع من توهم صفاء الحال إلى ركوب قبيح الأعمال

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another account is making grand claims that arise from diseased meanings.
rows.anchor: ويقال الاستدراج دعاوى عريضة صدرت عن معان مريضة

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another account is receiving abundant favor without giving thanks.
rows.anchor: ويقال الاستدراج إفاضة البر مع ( . . . ) الشكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reflection on the Messenger's character and the effects of divine nearness shows that his testimony is not fabricated.
rows.anchor: ليشهدوا أخلاق آثار التقريب بجملة أحواله - عليه السلام - ليعلموا أن ذلك الشاهد ليس بشاهد متخرص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's nearness is fragrant, but only those with experiential gnosis can perceive its scent; others cannot report his true state.
rows.anchor: يدرك ذلك النشر إلا بشم العرفان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God unveils the lights of His signs and removes the clouds of doubt; whoever is illuminated by them rises to witness divine power.
rows.anchor: فمن استضاء بها ترقى إلى شهود القدرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God lets reflective hearts glimpse realities of realization; whoever leaves the dwelling places of deficiency is carried to verification by the mounts of mystery.
rows.anchor: ألاح الله تعالى - لقلوب الناظرين بعيون الفكر - حقائق التحصيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People lost in false hopes forget how soon death may arrive, even while others make their shrouds or build for their enemies.
rows.anchor: الناس في مغاليط آمالهم ناسون لوشيك آجالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise's people are absorbed in reward and hell's people in torment, so neither group attends to those who call; God offers to guide them and show mercy.
rows.anchor: إن أصحاب الجنة - اليوم - في شغل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's grace toward His servants is that He guides them rather than abandoning them as their former companions did.
rows.anchor: وواحد متهم لا يهديكم فأنا أهديكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In paradise the worshippers praise God eternally, while God greets them with eternal peace and speech.
rows.anchor: الحمد ها هنا بمعنى المدح والثناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not hasten to answer a person's angry plea against himself; withholding the answer is mercy, though the servant may mistake it for neglect.
rows.anchor: وبرحمتنا عليهم لا نسمع منهم دعاءهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A trial can force sincere recourse to God, but once relief comes, comfort distracts the servant from the distress and makes it seem as though no trial occurred.
rows.anchor: فتحمله الضرورة على صدق الالتجاء إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An affliction that makes a person stand before God is more beneficial than a gift that makes the person forget Him and feel independent.
rows.anchor: بلاء يلجئك إلى الانتصاب بين يدي معبودك أجدى من عطاء ينسيك ويكفيك عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The source cites a report that if injustice were a house in paradise, God would subject it to ruin.
rows.anchor: لو كان الظلم بيتا في الجنة لسلط الله عليه الخراب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Injustice includes directing one's needs to creatures, relying on them for help, and attaching the heart to them in hope, thereby putting reliance in the wrong place.
rows.anchor: وضع العبد قصده - عند حوائجه - في المخلوقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The punishment for this injustice is a ruined heart whose route back to God is blocked; the need remains because the person persists in reliance on creatures.
rows.anchor: انسداد طريق رجوع ذلك القلب إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's people treated his warning as implausible; long days increased their disbelief until the promised event arrived suddenly and water burst from the oven as rain fell.
rows.anchor: لما كان يتوعدهم به نوح عليه السلام على وجه الاستبعاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taking pairs of creatures aboard preserves the continuation of their species.
rows.anchor: قلنا احمل فيها من كل زوجين اثنين

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: An unattributed report says Satan asked Noah to take him aboard; after Noah refused, Satan invoked his respite and God ordered Noah to carry him.
rows.anchor: فإن إبليس جاء إلى نوح

rows.speaker: ويقال
rows.claim: Another report says Noah had no place for his son but was ordered to take Satan, his greatest enemy.
rows.anchor: وأمر بحمل إبليس وهو أصعب الأعداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This contrast shows that the secrets of predestination do not follow human reasoning: God may exclude a son and admit an enemy, for He acts as He wills.
rows.anchor: أسرار التقدير لا تجري على قياس الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those excepted from rescue had already been destined for misery; the judgment of eternity cannot be overturned or contested.
rows.anchor: بأن حكم الأزل لا يرد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No warning or good deed can bring near someone whom God has cast away.
rows.anchor: وأن من أقصاه ربه لم يدنه تنبيه ولا بر ولا وعظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God blessed the few survivors through their descendants, so the world did not remain impaired after the destruction of Noah's people.
rows.anchor: في الذين نجاهم من نسله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's safety in the flood came through God's name, reliance upon Him, and His favor, not through multiplying schemes.
rows.anchor: وبتوكله على الله نجاته وراحته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah was outwardly apart from his son and, in the hidden decree, already apart from the fate assigned to Noah and his people.
rows.anchor: وكان في سر تقديره أيضا بمعزل عما سبق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's compassionate invitation says “with the disbelievers” rather than “one of the disbelievers” because his son's hypocritical state left him unsure; God then revealed that the son was among them by prior decree.
rows.anchor: لأن حالته كانت ملتبسة على نوح إذ كان ابنه ينافقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The son erred by seeing the floodwater as the source of destruction and the mountain as the source of safety; both peril and rescue come from God.
rows.anchor: رأى الهلاك من الماء وكان من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Noah's statement means that none can protect from God's command; an alternate reading says no one is immune from God.
rows.anchor: قيل أراد لا معصوم اليوم من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's love made Moses beloved to everyone who saw him.
rows.anchor: فما رآه احد إلا أحبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reports portray Moses as forceful in God's cause: he struck Pharaoh's face as an infant, struck the angel of death, pulled Harun by the head, asked to see God, and killed the Egyptian who sought his help.
rows.anchor: لطم وجه ملك الموت لما طالبه بقبض روحه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God overlooked Moses' bold actions because He had granted him authority and strength.
rows.anchor: ففي جميع هذا تجاوز الله عنه لما أعطاه من السلطان والقوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who chose to obey Pharaoh thereby deserved the fate he suffered.
rows.anchor: متابعة فرعون ، فاستحقوا ما استحقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They did not perceive their error and thought they were doing good; when Pharaoh leads them into fire, regret and weeping cannot end their unceasing torment.
rows.anchor: وكانوا يحسبون أنهم يحسنون صنعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were distant from faith in worldly life and from forgiveness and paradise in the next; their present separation is worse than their future burning.
rows.anchor: والذي لهم في الحال من الفرقة أعظم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet Muhammad was more honored than the prophets mentioned, and his community was more favored among nations, as the Qur'an calls it the best community.
rows.anchor: كنتم خير أمة أخرجت للناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God cannot be described as unjust: He has rightful, unrestricted authority over His own kingdom and rules as His will determines, with no claim imposed upon Him.
rows.anchor: فكيف يجوز الظلم في وصفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A creature's use of this statement to another creature might sound like an excuse, but it is no excuse when said of God, whose creation, kingdom, and judgment are His.
rows.anchor: ولكن في صفته لا يجوز العذر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives respite but does not neglect, judges without haste, and is not questioned about what He does.
